title: Muminin da ke Ɓoye
intro: A cikin manyan dakunan iko, inda rashin imani da zalunci suka mamaye, wata murya ta gaskiya ta yi magana daga wani wuri da ba a zata ba. Wannan mutumin ya ƙalubalanci ikon kare manzo, yana mai kasadar tsaron kansa don yaɗa gaskiya.
clues: Na zauna a ƙasar da ake mulkin kama-karya, ina bauta wa wani mai mulki wanda ya yi iƙirarin allahntaka.
Na ɓoye gaskiyan imanina tsawon shekaru da yawa, ina jin tsoron sakamakon bayyana su.
Lokacin da wani manzo ya zo da hujjoji bayyanannu, na yi imani, amma mutanena sun yi masa makirci.
Na tsaya a gaban azzalumi da majalisarsa, ina jayayya cewa bai kamata su kashe wani manzo marar laifi ba.
Na yi musu gargaɗi game da hukuncin al'ummomin da suka gabata waɗanda suka ƙi gaskiya, kamar mutanen Nuhu da Ada.
Allah ya cece ni daga mugun makircinsu, kuma na shaida halakar gwamnatin zalunci.

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: An cece shi daga cutarwa yayin da aka halaka azzalumai
Ya zama mai iko mai iko
An jefa shi cikin wuta kuma ya fito ba tare da ya ji rauni ba
Yawo a cikin jeji tsawon shekaru arba'in
outcome.answer: An cece shi daga cutarwa yayin da aka halaka azzalumai

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
